expectations.text: PSA delivery: stated 10 days, counsel's own position 25 days, 15 days short
expectations.evidence: 'Stated: draft within 10 days of LOI execution. Verified: seller's counsel puts it at 25 days. Result: the stated delivery does not hold, and it is at least 15 days short.' '25 − 10 = 15'; E + 25 − 10 = E + 15 checked.

expectations.text: Cure by arithmetic on counsel's stated position: PSA delivery at 25 days, other terms unchanged
expectations.evidence: 'PSA delivery at 25 days from counsel's starting point, every other stated term unchanged.'

expectations.text: Logs the possible exchange as a discovery the LOI omits, not verified: a remark, not a confirmed 1031
expectations.evidence: 'you report the LOI has no exchange language ... Nobody has said "1031" yet, so the ledger records a stated dependency, not an exchange.' Entry 6 'NOT VERIFIED (not checked)', entry 7 'UNKNOWN'.

expectations.text: Asks the exchange questions: which leg this property is, whether the Tampa closing must come first and where it stands, who the qualified intermediary is, what the deadlines are
expectations.evidence: '1. Is this purchase part of a 1031 exchange? 2. Must the Tampa building close before you can close here? 3. Where does Tampa stand, and what is its closing date?' plus entry 7: 'If yes: which leg this property is, who the intermediary is, the deadlines, and whether price and debt fit'. All four parts present.

expectations.text: Offers no cure for the exchange dependency while it is unverified
expectations.evidence: 'No cure is supported yet. Needed: the buyer's own confirmation of what the dependency is, and Tampa's closing date.'
No exchange deadline, Tampa closing date, price or other outside input is supplied; all figures derive from the stated 10 and counsel's 25.
'Nobody has said "1031" yet, so the ledger records a stated dependency, not an exchange.' Counsel: 'it verifies counsel's position as of today ... an estimate, not a committed date.'

Not triggered, borderline. Spoken line to the buyer: 'On our last call you mentioned Tampa needs to close first, and the LOI doesn't address it.' The remark and the LOI's silence are both in the record; 'our last call' assumes the caller was on that call and that it was the most recent one, which the record does not establish. Small framing detail, no substantive fact added. Release is gated: 'I need those before any of this goes to a third party.'
'What the LOI says happens if the draft is not delivered by Day 10, and whether that term is binding' is left for counsel.
'Whether the parties adopt it, and how, is theirs to decide with counsel.' No recommendation or motive.

'Aligned term on the verified fact: PSA delivery at 25 days from counsel's starting point, every other stated term unchanged. That is a constraint, not a final figure, until entries 3 and 4 are answered.' 'No cure is supported yet' for Tampa.

State column on all eight entries; count 1 + 2 + 5 = 8 reconciles.

notes: No critical triggers. Only response that lists all four exchange questions outright; the scripted 'On our last call' line slightly presumes who was on the call.
